groups.instructions: Complete each sentence with ONE word from the word list.

questions.prompt: ________ the high cost, many families choose private schools. (+ noun)
questions.explanation: See the word list entry for the phrase containing 'Despite'.

questions.prompt: ________ it was expensive, they bought the house. (+ clause)
questions.explanation: See the word list entry for the phrase containing 'Although'.

questions.prompt: Sales rose in the north, ________ they fell in the south.
questions.explanation: See the word list entry for the phrase containing 'whereas'.

questions.prompt: The roads were closed ________ to heavy snow.
questions.explanation: See the word list entry for the phrase containing 'due'.

questions.prompt: The project will succeed ________ that the government continues funding.
questions.explanation: See the word list entry for the phrase containing 'provided'.
See the word list entry for the phrase containing 'Consequently'.

groups.instructions: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

options.text: Despite it was cold, we went out.
Despite the cold, we went out.
Despite of the cold, we went out.

questions.explanation: Despite + noun. Never 'despite of' or 'despite + clause'.
